question_en: Korean movies and TV series, all together
question_fr: Films et séries télévisées coréens, tous ensemble
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql:
SELECT U.ID_CONTENT, U.CONTENT_TYPE
  FROM (
        (SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'movie' AS CONTENT_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED AS SORT_KEY
           FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE
          WHERE T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY.COUNTRY_CODE = 'KR'
           AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY.DELETED = 0
           AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.DELETED = 0 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IS_MOVIE = 1
          ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC
          LIMIT 10)
        UNION ALL
        (SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'serie' AS CONTENT_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_SERIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED AS SORT_KEY
           FROM T_WC_T2S_SERIE
          JOIN T_WC_T2S_SERIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY ON T_WC_T2S_SERIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY.ID_SERIE = T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE
          WHERE T_WC_T2S_SERIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY.COUNTRY_CODE = 'KR'
           AND T_WC_T2S_SERIE_PRODUCTION_COUNTRY.DELETED = 0
           AND T_WC_T2S_SERIE.DELETED = 0
          ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_SERIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC
          LIMIT 10)
       ) AS U
 ORDER BY U.SORT_KEY DESC 
LIMIT 20
